# mtg-mcp

> A C# MCP server that gives LLMs grounded Magic: The Gathering card, deck,
> source, and statistical evidence plus safe deck-planning operations.

Current code, tests, project files, checked-in configuration, and `AGENTS.md`
are authoritative. This file is a compact orientation index, not a second
instruction file.

This branch contains the finished `0.9.0` server: local decks in SQLite, manual
deck imports and exports, Scryfall evidence, optional guarded Archidekt sync,
and the optional documented Playgroup public API. The old server remains in Git
history and released packages, but its production code is not in this branch.
Read the [rewrite guide](docs/rewrite-guide.md) before using historical design
or API documents to plan new work.

## Start Here

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository rules, architecture boundaries, safety, planning, and validation.
- [README](README.md): Current deck, Scryfall, Archidekt, and Playgroup tools, configuration, product direction, and development commands.
- [North star](docs/north-star.md): Product mission, evidence hierarchy, and non-goals.
- [Design goals](docs/design-goals.md): Architecture, quality, testing, and MCP principles.
- [Rewrite guide](docs/rewrite-guide.md): The released `0.9.0` boundary, lasting rules, and how to start new work without reopening the rewrite.
- [Rewrite program](docs/llms/plcs/completed/evidence-first-mcp-rewrite-program/README.md): The approved overall `0.9.0` rules and child-packet list.
- [Capability toolsets](docs/llms/plcs/completed/mcp-capability-toolsets/README.md): The startup-selected tool groups and fixed profiles.
- [Local deck store](docs/llms/plcs/completed/local-deck-store/README.md): Implemented deck contracts, SQLite lifecycle, tools, and acceptance evidence.
- [Manual deck interchange](docs/llms/plcs/completed/manual-deck-interchange/README.md): Native JSON, plain text, and manual provider export files, with clear limits on what each format keeps.
- [Pre-statistics hardening](docs/llms/plcs/completed/mcp-contract-and-adapter-hardening/README.md): AMEND-005 work: exact identity matching and clearer adapter boundaries.
- [Exact deck statistics](docs/llms/plcs/completed/exact-deck-statistics/README.md): Eight exact-math tools with caller-defined populations and assumptions; no legality checks or recommendations.
- [Scryfall card data and evidence](docs/llms/plcs/completed/scryfall-corpus-and-evidence/README.md): Official card-data install, API cache, replay, and tag evidence.
- [Archidekt synchronization](docs/llms/plcs/completed/archidekt-deck-sync/README.md): Optional deck, folder, snapshot, pull/push, pacing, and safe live checks.
- [Playgroup public API](docs/llms/plcs/completed/playgroup-public-api/README.md): Optional documented operations, provider evidence, mode guards, safe write tests, and limited live reads.
- [Deterministic deck categorization](docs/llms/plcs/completed/deterministic-deck-categorization/README.md): Implemented caller-configured tag-rule validation, preview, and guarded apply.
- [Rewrite stabilization](docs/llms/plcs/completed/rewrite-stabilization-cutover/README.md): Completed package, documentation, release, and rollback evidence for `0.9.0`.
- [Deckbuilding evolution](docs/llms/plcs/completed/evidence-first-deckbuilding-evolution/README.md): Completed ownership cleanup, current toolchain update, source decisions, tag repair, and on-curve estimate.
- [Potential features](docs/potential-features.md): Deferred ideas that are not stable rewrite scope.
- [Taskfile](Taskfile.yml): Supported local and CI operations; run `task --list`.
